sloka: कच्चित्ते दयिता: सर्वे कृषिगोरक्षजीविन: ।वार्त्तायां संश्रितस्तात लोको हि सुखमेधते ॥ २.१००.४८॥
transliteration: kaccitte dayitā: sarve kṛṣigorakṣajīvina: ।vārttāyāṁ saṁśritastāta loko hi sukhamedhate ॥ 2.100.48॥

translations.english: I trust you nourish them and also afford portection and prevent adversities. A king must protect all those people living in his country in accordanc with righteousness.
